data.name: Chart style text is built from config keys without escaping
data.Risk: The chart style element is filled by putting each config key and colour into a template string and passing it as HTML. The time chart builds its config keys from row data, so a key that holds a closing brace or a closing style tag would change the style rules or end the element. The data comes from local logs, so the exposure is small, but nothing validates the key. `web/src/components/ui/chart.tsx:102` `web/src/components/ui/chart.tsx:92` `web/src/components/chart-time.tsx:65`
data.Mitigation: Map keys to safe indexed names such as series-1 before they enter the style text, and keep the readable name only in the label.

data.name: A chart part outside its container throws with no error boundary above it
data.Risk: The chart hook throws a plain error when no container is above it, and the app is mounted with one render call and no error boundary, so the error would leave the page blank. `web/src/components/ui/chart.tsx:33` `web/src/main.tsx:7`
data.Mitigation: Add one error boundary around the app that shows the existing error card with a retry button.

data.name: A chart legend label is empty for a series with no config entry
data.Risk: The legend content prints only the config label, with no fallback to the series name, so a series missing from the config shows a colour square and no text, while the tooltip falls back to the raw name. `web/src/components/ui/chart.tsx:319` `web/src/components/ui/chart.tsx:249`
data.Mitigation: Fall back to the series name in the legend as the tooltip does.

data.name: Should the toast host ship in the main app
data.Question: In the web source only the prototype page mounts the toast host, and the shipped dashboard entry mounts only the tooltip provider. Is the toast primitive meant for a later screen or is it dead code in the shipped app? `web/src/prototype/Prototype.tsx:109` `web/src/main.tsx:9`

data.name: Are the chart legend parts still needed
data.Question: The wrapper exports a legend and a legend content part, but the time chart draws its own key list instead. Does any screen plan to use these two, or can they go? `web/src/components/ui/chart.tsx:270` `web/src/components/chart-time.tsx:174`
